User Story: As a user, I run `python -m aetherlab` and the desktop app opens.
Expected Behavior: main() with no --smoke imports ui.app.run_app, builds QApplication + MainWindow(load_settings()), shows it, returns app.exec(). RuntimeError (missing PyQt6) prints to stderr and returns exit code 2.

User Story: As a developer, I run `python -m aetherlab --smoke` to exercise the whole pipeline without a GUI.
Expected Behavior: --smoke [prompt] runs AetherLabPipeline.run() and prints cache key, solver model, keywords, RAG hit count, scene engine, scene status; returns 0. Default prompt is the damped oscillator.
Notes: Verified: smoke exit 0; scene status line present

User Story: As a developer, I pass my own prompt to --smoke.
Expected Behavior: `--smoke "..."` uses the provided string (nargs='?', const=default) instead of the default prompt.
Notes: Verified: nargs='?' const + explicit prompt both parse

User Story: As a user, if AetherLab crashes the watchdog restarts it.
Expected Behavior: aetherlab_watchdog.py relaunches on non-zero exit with exponential backoff; stops on clean exit (0).
Notes: Verified: watchdog present with backoff logic

User Story: As a user without PyQt6, I get an actionable message, not a stack trace.
Expected Behavior: require_qt() raises RuntimeError with `pip install PyQt6` instructions; main() catches and prints to stderr, exit 2.
Notes: Verified: require_qt raises RuntimeError w/ install hint

User Story: As a user, my AETHERLAB_*/OPENAI_* env vars configure the app.
Expected Behavior: load_settings() reads AETHERLAB_DATA_DIR/CACHE_PATH/CHROMA_PATH/LIBRARY_DIR, AETHERLAB_OPENAI_API_KEY|OPENAI_API_KEY, base URL, LLM_MODEL, LLM_TIMEOUT. Missing → defaults.
Notes: Verified. BUG-5: llm_context_window setting was defined but unused (dead config).

User Story: As a user, values I save in the Settings dialog survive restarts.
Expected Behavior: save_app_config writes data_dir/settings.json (drops empty/None); load_app_config reads it; feeds load_settings. app_config_path honors AETHERLAB_DATA_DIR.
Notes: Verified: save/load round-trip; None dropped; path honored

User Story: As a user, explicit env vars win over saved config, which wins over the legacy Qwen file.
Expected Behavior: load_settings resolves model/api_key/base_url in that order; provider_source labels the winning tier.

User Story: As a Qwen Code user, AetherLab auto-detects my provider.
Expected Behavior: load_qwen_settings extracts model name, base URL, and api key (via envKey/env) without logging secrets; returns {} if absent/corrupt.

User Story: As a user, I open Settings to edit provider, rendering, and paths.
Expected Behavior: SettingsDialog: API key (password + reveal eye), Base URL, Model, Render engine (Manim only), Default quality, Library path + Browse, Data path + Browse. Save persists via save_app_config and applies via dataclasses.replace.
Notes: Verified. BUG-4: Settings 'Data path' field never persisted (save/load ignore data_dir).

User Story: As a Windows user my data goes under %LOCALAPPDATA%\AetherLab; else ~/.aetherlab.
Expected Behavior: _default_data_dir / _default_chroma_path branch on LOCALAPPDATA env presence.

User Story: As a user, I type a problem and press Enter / Run / Ctrl+Enter to start.
Expected Behavior: CommandBar validates non-empty and run visible, emits submitted(str), clears field. MainWindow.start_pipeline launches the worker.

User Story: As a user, I pick a pre-made example to fill the prompt.
Expected Behavior: Examples button opens a QMenu of 10 prompts anchored above the bar; selecting fills the field and focuses it.

User Story: As a user, I choose Draft/Standard/High before running.
Expected Behavior: QualityCombo maps Draft/Standard/High → l/m/h via get_render_quality; set_quality selects by flag (Settings default).
Notes: Verified: quality maps Draft/Standard/High→l/m/h; set_quality by flag

User Story: As a user, the Run button becomes Cancel while a run is in flight.
Expected Behavior: set_busy(True) hides Run, shows Cancel, disables input; cancel_button emits cancel_requested.

User Story: As a user, I watch Solve→RAG→Scene→Render advance.
Expected Behavior: PipelineWorker runs solve, ensure-ingest, RAG+scene, render; emits solver/rag/scene/render_ready, status, and progress(pct,label). RAG and scene are awaited within one async run.

User Story: As a user, each stage node shows pending/active/complete/error with elapsed time and a pulse.
Expected Behavior: PipelineStepper paints 4 nodes, emerald connectors, active pulse + rotating arc, per-stage elapsed seconds, and an inline Cancel hit-target under the active node.
Notes: Verified. BUG-1: duplicate reset() shadowed the clearing one; stale elapsed leaked across runs.

User Story: As a user, Escape / Cancel / the stepper Cancel stops the run.
Expected Behavior: worker.cancel() sets a flag; _check_cancelled between stages raises _PipelineCancelled → status 'cancelled'. UI restores ready state, hides busy, shows a warning toast.

User Story: As a user, I can't start a second run while one is active.
Expected Behavior: start_pipeline returns early if worker.isRunning(); status shows 'Pipeline is already running.'

User Story: As a user, repeated runs don't leak old worker signal connections.
Expected Behavior: start_pipeline disconnects every signal of the previous worker and deleteLater()s it before wiring the new one.

User Story: As a user, closing mid-run doesn't orphan the thread.
Expected Behavior: closeEvent cancels the worker and waits up to 5s.

User Story: As a user with an API key, the LLM returns a summary, steps, keywords, variables, and an optional plot.
Expected Behavior: AsyncLLMCoordinator._solve_remote calls the OpenAI-compatible chat API (temperature 0.2), parses strict JSON, coerces variables→floats, keeps the raw plot dict.
Notes: Verified: remote solve path present (temp 0.2, plot key)

User Story: As a user without a key (or on API error), I still get a keyword-based scaffold.
Expected Behavior: _fallback builds 5 canned steps, merges DEFAULT_VARIABLES with request params, sets model_name 'deterministic-fallback', and attaches fallback_plot_payload().

User Story: As a user, my prompt yields ranked keywords including multi-word physics phrases.
Expected Behavior: extract_keywords tokenizes, drops stopwords, ranks by frequency, and prepends matched phrases (fourier transform, navier stokes, ...) recognizing both spaced and hyphenated forms.

User Story: As a user of reasoning models, wrapped/notated JSON still parses.
Expected Behavior: _parse_json strips <think>...</think> then json.loads; on failure extracts the first {...} block.

User Story: As a user, the solver can describe the single curve that captures its result.
Expected Behavior: System prompt requests an optional plot {kind,x,y,t_range,x_range,y_range,labels}; kept raw on SolverResult.plot and validated at canvas-build time.
Notes: Verified: plot dict kept; non-dict → None

User Story: As a user, solver-provided math expressions render without ever eval-ing arbitrary code.
Expected Behavior: plotting.compile_expression parses with ast, walks a strict whitelist (numeric literals, + - * / ** % //, whitelisted numpy fns, pi/e/tau, t + params), int→float transform, compiles to a numpy-vectorized fn. Rejects names/calls/ops outside the whitelist.

User Story: As a user, pathological expressions can't hang or blow memory.
Expected Behavior: MAX_EXPR_CHARS 512, MAX_AST_NODES 200, MAX_T_SPAN 1e4 clamp; OverflowError→inf, ZeroDivisionError→nan; '^' normalized to '**'; results broadcast to the sample grid.
Notes: Verified: all 6 unsafe exprs rejected; ^→** works

User Story: As a user, a malformed plot payload degrades gracefully instead of crashing.
Expected Behavior: compile_plot validates kind∈{explicit,parametric}, finite lo<hi ranges via _pair, clamps t-span, compiles x/y; fallback_plot_payload() gives the deterministic damped-oscillator curve.
Notes: Verified: fallback payload compiles; bad kind rejected

User Story: As a user, identical problems map to one cache entry regardless of whitespace/param order.
Expected Behavior: make_key hashes the canonical payload (normalized prompt + alphabetically sorted params + session id).

User Story: As a user, each stage result is stored independently so partial re-runs skip finished stages.
Expected Behavior: SessionCache stores solver/rag/scene JSON in separate columns; get() rehydrates with cached=True; _store_json whitelists the column name (SQL-injection guard).
Notes: Verified: independent stage storage + column whitelist

User Story: As a user, changing the model (or adding a key) invalidates a stale solver cache.
Expected Behavior: _solver_cache_usable rejects a fallback result once a key exists, and any result whose model_name isn't the current model or 'deterministic-fallback'.
Notes: Verified: fallback+key rejected; wrong model rejected

Feature: Scene cache invalidation on engine change
User Story: As a user, switching Manim engine regenerates the scene.
Expected Behavior: Scene reused only if cached.engine == current engine and status ∈ {compiled, rendered}.
Notes: Verified: scene reused only on engine+status match

User Story: As a user, a deleted cached video re-renders automatically.
Expected Behavior: A 'rendered' scene whose video_path no longer exists is re-rendered; needs_render covers compiled and missing-video rendered.

User Story: As a user with ChromaDB, references come from vector similarity.
Expected Behavior: LocalVectorRag._try_chromadb queries the 'textbooks' collection; score = 1/(1+distance); returns top-N hits with excerpts; backend 'chromadb'.

User Story: As a user without ChromaDB, references come from keyword frequency.
Expected Behavior: _filesystem_search walks the library, scores text/PDF by keyword counts, extracts a 520-char excerpt centered on the first match; PDFs are strided-sampled (≤40 pages). backend 'filesystem'.
Notes: Verified. BUG-3: filesystem RAG score normalization (see F38).

User Story: As a user with no keywords or no library, I get an explanatory empty state, not an error.
Expected Behavior: search returns backend 'none' for empty keywords; 'filesystem-missing-library' when the dir is absent; ReferencePanel shows a tailored empty hint.

User Story: As a user, hits render as cards with source, page, score pill, excerpt, copy, and Open.
Expected Behavior: _RagHitCard: score pill emerald≥0.8/amber≥0.5/gray, Copy excerpt, Open launches the source file via QDesktopServices. Backend label shows 'backend · N hits'.
Notes: Verified. BUG-3: filesystem RAG score is a raw count, not 0-1; pill/label semantics broke.

User Story: As a user, my library is indexed automatically the first time I run.
Expected Behavior: _ensure_ingested checks the ChromaDB collection count; if empty and a library exists, LibraryIngestor.ingest() runs (both pipeline and worker paths).

User Story: As a user, re-indexing only processes new/changed files.
Expected Behavior: A JSON manifest keyed by path stores mtime+size+chunks; pending_files / _needs_ingest skip unchanged files; manifest saved after each completed file (atomic tmp-rename).

User Story: As a user, text is chunked on sentence boundaries with overlap.
Expected Behavior: chunk_text: 1400-char windows, 180 overlap, prefers to break at '. '/'; '/newline past the half-way point.

User Story: As a user, my PDFs are indexed page-by-page.
Expected Behavior: _chunks_from_pdf opens with fitz, chunks each page, tags metadata with page number; skips silently if fitz unavailable or the file won't open.

User Story: As a user, indexing is chunked, cancellable, and resumes where it left off.
Expected Behavior: ingest upserts in batches of 96, checks should_cancel between batches, returns partial count on cancel; a cancelled file stays out of the manifest so it's reprocessed next run. reset=True rebuilds and clears the manifest.

User Story: As a user, I see every library file with size and an Indexed/Pending chip.
Expected Behavior: LibraryPanel.refresh lists .pdf/.txt/.md/.tex with MB/KB size and a chip colored by manifest membership; shows a dashed empty state with CTAs when empty.

User Story: As a user, I copy documents from a folder into my library.
Expected Behavior: _add_folder copies matching files (skipping existing names) into the library dir, reports the count, refreshes, and kicks off an incremental re-index.

User Story: As a user, Re-index picks up changes; Ctrl+click forces a full rebuild.
Expected Behavior: _reindex_clicked reads the Ctrl modifier; _start_ingest runs _IngestWorker (background QThread) with progress + cancel; button disables and relabels while running.
Notes: Verified: incremental/full reindex via background worker

User Story: As a user, I download free OpenStax university-physics textbooks into my library.
Expected Behavior: StarterLibraryDialog lists 8 CC-BY OpenStax books (University Physics Vol 1-3 default; Astronomy 2e, Calculus Vol 1-3, College Physics 2e opt-in) with real sizes + a warning for the extras; Download checks ≥500MB free, streams via _DownloadWorker, writes ATTRIBUTION, then auto-indexes.
Notes: Verified. BUG-6: cancelling a starter download after >=1 book still auto-started indexing (re-showing the strip Cancel had just hidden); cancel now skips auto-index.

User Story: As a user, downloads survive AV locks and partial failures.
Expected Behavior: download_book streams to <name>.part, atomically os.replace()s (one retry after AV lock), skips files >5MB already present; resolve_pdf_urls pulls current URLs from the OpenStax CMS with hardcoded fallbacks; one failed book doesn't abort the rest.

User Story: As a user, the LLM writes custom Manim code for my problem.
Expected Behavior: SceneGenerator sends the 18-rule system prompt + structured context (temperature 0.4, max_tokens 16384), then _extract_code strips <think>/fences, forces the class name, injects imports, and requires a class + construct().
Notes: Verified: extract strips think/fences+renames; context budget wired (BUG-5)

User Story: As a user, generated code is compile()-checked and retried once on SyntaxError.
Expected Behavior: generate_scene_async compiles each attempt; on SyntaxError retries up to max_retries=1, then falls back to the static template (status compiled/compile-error).

User Story: As a user without a key, I get a deterministic template scene filled with my data.
Expected Behavior: _build_scene_code fills _MANIM_SCENE_TEMPLATE with truncated title/summary/steps/variables + RAG count; always animates in (no empty video); compiles under Manim Community.

User Story: As a user, if the LLM scene fails, a ValueTracker-based animated fallback uses my variables.
Expected Behavior: _fallback_scene builds axes + always_redraw curve/dot from damping/stiffness/mass and animates damping with there_and_back.
Notes: Verified: dynamic fallback compiles w/ ValueTracker

User Story: As a user, AetherLab detects manim (Community) or manimlib.
Expected Behavior: detect_engine prefers importable 'manim' → 'manim-community', else 'manimlib' → 'manimgl', else 'generated-only' with diagnostics.

User Story: As a user, the compiled scene renders to MP4 via a manim subprocess.
Expected Behavior: render_scene writes the .py to a temp render dir, runs `python -m manim render -q<q> --fps <tier> --media_dir ...`, CREATE_NO_WINDOW on Windows, cleans old renders, then finds the newest MP4.
Notes: Verified: render invokes manim render w/ fps+media_dir

User Story: As a user, rendering matches my hardware (fps + priority).
Expected Behavior: _detect_render_tier: ≥16GB/≥6cpu → cinematic 60fps; ≥10GB → standard 30fps; else constrained 30fps below-normal priority. Always passes explicit --fps.

User Story: As a user, renders can't hang forever.
Expected Behavior: timeout_map l=240/m=420/h=600/k=900s; TimeoutExpired→status 'render-timeout'; non-zero exit→'render-error' with tail of stderr.

User Story: As a user, I never get a stale video back.
Expected Behavior: _clean_old_renders removes media/videos/<scene>/ before rendering; _find_video returns the most recently modified MP4 via rglob.

User Story: As a user, AetherLab finds the right manim to run.
Expected Behavior: _find_manim_command prefers `sys.executable -m manim`, else shutil.which('manim'), else None (code-only).

User Story: As a user, I switch between the live canvas, the video, and the code.
Expected Behavior: SimulationPanel top-bar pills map to stack pages 1/2/3; loading overlay is page 0.
Notes: Verified: pill tabs map to stack pages

User Story: As a user, I read the generated code, copy it, or export scene.py.
Expected Behavior: Read-only QPlainTextEdit; Copy code and Export scene.py buttons; diagnostics appended each prefixed with '# '.
Notes: Verified: code viewer shows diagnostics prefixed with #

User Story: As a user, I play/pause/stop/seek/step/scrub speed on the rendered video.
Expected Behavior: QMediaPlayer + QVideoWidget; prev/next frame (±33ms), seek slider (drag-aware), 25-200% speed, m:ss time label; autoplays once media reaches LoadedMedia; falls back to code view if the file is missing.
Notes: Verified: video player + time label formatting

User Story: As a user, one shortcut flips between canvas and code.
Expected Behavior: _toggle_code_view switches the workspace to Scene then toggles canvas↔code on the SimulationPanel stack.

User Story: As a user, I see a live-animated plot with a glowing tracer and trail.
Expected Behavior: LiveCanvas paints radial-gradient bg, nice-step grid, boxed axes with labels, glow curves, a 24-point fading trail, and a tracer with a coordinate label at ~30fps.

User Story: As a user, the canvas prefers the solver's own curve, but never crashes on bad output.
Expected Behavior: build_canvas_state uses compile_plot when a plot payload exists; on any error logs and falls back to name-based domain families.
Notes: Verified: plot-driven curve; bad plot falls back

User Story: As a user, the curve type matches my variables.
Expected Behavior: _DOMAIN_MAP routes damping/stiffness→damped oscillator, gravity/length→pendulum, else generic Lissajous.

User Story: As a user, I toggle a y-vs-dy/dt overlay.
Expected Behavior: The checkbox rebuilds state; _phase_overlay_for (payload path) or _phase_portrait_curves (legacy) adds a dashed violet finite-difference curve.

User Story: As a user, I scroll to zoom, drag to pan, hover for coordinates, and Ctrl+0 to reset.
Expected Behavior: wheelEvent zooms 0.1-50×; left-drag pans in data space; hover draws a crosshair + (x,y) label; reset_view restores zoom/pan; zoom indicator shows when ≠1×.

User Story: As a user, the empty canvas guides me, multi-curve plots get a legend, and hidden tabs stop animating.
Expected Behavior: paintEvent draws a 'No curve data' hint when empty; _draw_legend renders for ≥2 curves; show/hideEvent start/stop the animation timer.
Notes: Verified: empty canvas safe; effective ranges default

User Story: As a user, I tune each variable via a slider and a precise spinbox, and reset to the original.
Expected Behavior: ParameterDock builds slider(1000 ticks)+QDoubleSpinBox(4dp, range [-span,span])+↺ per variable; changes redraw the canvas live and update the analysis panel.
Notes: Verified: negative range preserved on update_variable (BUG-2)

Expected Behavior: blockSignals prevents recursion; slider↔spinbox mirror; span expands (spinbox.setRange) when |value|>span.
Notes: Verified. BUG-2: update_variable used setRange(0,span)/`value>span`; dropped negative range.

User Story: As a user, I collapse the parameter strip to save space.
Expected Behavior: The ▼ header toggles the slider container; the Params rail item reveals/hides the Scene-page side panel.

User Story: As a user, I see the analytical summary and violet keyword chips.
Expected Behavior: AnalysisPanel.set_solver_result fills the cyan mono banner (with a [cache] note when cached) and up to 6 keyword chips.
Notes: Verified: summary banner + cache note + chips

User Story: As a user, each step is a collapsible card; I can expand/collapse all and copy.
Expected Behavior: _CollapsibleStepWidget toggles body on header click; Expand-all button; Copy copies summary+steps; per-step copy.

User Story: As a user, before running I see a placeholder.
Expected Behavior: An EmptyHint label shows until set_solver_result hides it.

User Story: As a user, the 5 rail items (Solve/Refs/Scene/Params/History) drive one workspace.
Expected Behavior: SidebarNav emits item_selected; _on_sidebar_select maps to empty/running/solve/scene/library/history; running/empty stand in until a result exists.

User Story: As a user, I switch rail items by keyboard.
Expected Behavior: Ctrl+1..5 call sidebar.select(idx); SidebarNav.keyPressEvent moves selection with Up/Down/Left/Right.

User Story: As a user, the Params item is disabled until a run produces variables.
Expected Behavior: set_result_available(False) disables item 3 until on_solver_ready enables it.

Expected Behavior: on_scene_ready hides loading, sets the scene, and calls sidebar.select(2).
Notes: Verified: scene ready auto-switches to Scene

User Story: As a user, my past runs persist across sessions.
Expected Behavior: HistoryPanel.init_persistence creates the history table and loads the last 100; add_entry inserts a row and a status-colored list item.

User Story: As a user, double-clicking an entry re-runs that prompt.

User Story: As a user, I clear all entries from the list and the database.

User Story: As a user, errors/warnings/success/info appear as a dismissible banner with optional Details.

User Story: As a user, a failed run shows an inline banner and a non-modal traceback on Details.
Expected Behavior: SimulationPanel.show_error_banner shows the banner; _show_error_details opens a single (deduped, WA_DeleteOnClose) traceback window.
Notes: Verified: error banner + deduped details window

User Story: As a user, the failing stage turns red and the status bar explains.
Expected Behavior: on_failure sets the current stage 'error', updates the status bar with stage+message, and returns to Solve/Empty.

User Story: As a user, I export the derivation to a .tex file.

User Story: As a user, the app has a cohesive dark cyan theme.

User Story: As a user, each problem only produces the outputs it actually needs.
Expected Behavior: Planner.plan() returns a LessonPlan{needs_numeric,needs_2d,needs_3d,needs_animation,needs_pdf,rationale} via one strict-JSON LLM call; the heuristic classifier routes 'explain X conceptually' to pdf-only, dynamics prompts to numeric+2d+animation, and 3-D field prompts to needs_3d.
